---
title: "Booth sizes with DuckDB"
output: html_notebook
---

Do larger constituencies have more polling parts, or larger polling parts?
Count retained cards within each part before comparing constituencies.

```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

root <- path.expand("~/Documents/work/data_work/bangalore/voters/final_roll_2026")
data_dir <- file.path(root, "data_combined")

dbConnect(duckdb()) ->
  con

duckdb::tbl_file(
  con,
  file.path(data_dir, "*.parquet")
) ->
  cards
```

```{r booth-counts}
cards %>%
  summarise(
    retained = sum(!is_deleted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(ac, constituency_name, part)
  ) ->
  booth_counts
```

Keep zero-retained parts in the comparison. Filtering cards before counting would lose them.

```{r booth-quantiles}
booth_counts %>%
  summarise(
    booths = n(),
    median_cards = median(retained, na.rm = TRUE),
    p10 = quantile(retained, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90 = quantile(retained, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(ac, constituency_name)
  ) %>%
  collect() ->
  booth_sizes
```

```{r booth-size-plot}
booth_sizes %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(constituency_name, median_cards))) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = p10,
      xend = p90,
      yend = reorder(constituency_name, median_cards)
    ),
    colour = "#B8B8B8",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = median_cards),
    colour = "#0072B2",
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mahadevapura has the largest median polling part",
    subtitle = "Dot: median; line: 10th–90th percentile within each constituency",
    x = "Retained cards per polling part",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: November 2026 final-roll card OCR. Retained cards are not deduplicated people."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

The median part has 753 retained cards in Mahadevapura, against 544 in Dasarahalli.
Constituency totals alone hide this difference in part size.

Does that line up with how many parts each constituency has?

```{r parts-versus-size}
booth_sizes %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(booths, median_cards),
    constituencies = n()
  )
```

The correlation is 0.43 across the 28 constituencies. More parts and larger parts both contribute to constituency size.

```{r disconnect}
dbDisconnect(
  con,
  shutdown = TRUE
)
```
